Wasterful habits raised the electric bill. 浪費的習慣提高了電費。
Wasterful printing used too much paper. 浪費的列印用了太多紙張。
Wasterfully, he bought food he never ate. 他揮霍地買了從不吃的食物。
Wasterfully, the shop kept every light on. 那家店浪費地讓每盞燈都亮著。
Wasterfulness became obvious after the move. 搬家後，揮霍的程度變得明顯。
Wasterfulness drained the club's funds. 揮霍耗掉了社團的經費。
Wastethrift spent his pay on gadgets. 揮霍的人把薪水花在小玩意上。
Wastethrift borrowed money for another party. 那個揮霍的人為了另一場派對借錢。
Wasteword made the instructions harder to read. 贅詞讓說明更難閱讀。
Wasteword disappeared after the editor's revision. 編輯修訂後，無意義的字消失了。
Wasteyard stored broken appliances behind the fence. 垃圾堆置場在圍籬後存放壞掉的家電。
Wasteyard workers loaded metal onto trucks. 垃圾場工人把金屬裝上卡車。
Wasting illness made the patient lose weight. 消耗性疾病使病人體重下降。
Wasting heat escaped through the open door. 耗損的熱氣從敞開的門逸出。
Wastingly, the pump ran through the night. 水泵浪費地整夜運轉。
Wastingly, the heater warmed an empty room. 暖氣浪費地加熱一間空房。
Wastingness showed in the patient's thin arms. 病人消瘦的狀態顯現在纖細手臂上。
Wastingness required careful medical care. 衰弱狀態需要細心醫療照護。
Wastland surrounded the ruined fort. 荒地環繞著毀壞的堡壘。
Wastland received little rain each year. 這片不毛之地每年雨量很少。
Wastrel spent the rent money at the bar. 揮霍度日的人把房租花在酒吧。
Wastrel ignored every chance to work. 那個遊手好閒的人無視每個工作機會。
Wastrife broke out over the inheritance. 爭吵因遺產而爆發。
Wastrife ended when both neighbors apologized. 兩位鄰居道歉後，衝突結束了。
He had a wasty habit of spending money too quickly. 他有個揮霍金錢的壞習慣。
The wasty shed looked ready to fall apart. 那間邋遢的棚屋看起來快要塌了。

meaning: 瓦蘇庫馬人；坦尚尼亞的一個族群
sentences: The article described Wasukuma farming customs. 那篇文章介紹了瓦蘇庫馬人的農耕習俗。
A Wasukuma elder spoke at the community meeting. 一位瓦蘇庫馬族長者在社區會議上發言。

meaning: 瓦斯瓦希里人；斯瓦希里族群
sentences: The museum highlighted Waswahili trade history. 博物館重點展示了瓦斯瓦希里人的貿易歷史。
A Waswahili sailor guided the boat into port. 一位瓦斯瓦希里水手把船引進港口。
Wat appeared as a surname in the old register. 舊登記冊裡把這個字列作姓氏。
The village of Wat sat beside the river road. 那個同名村落位於河邊道路旁。
A narrow wat carried rainwater down the hill. 一條狹窄的小水道把雨水引下山坡。
The farmer cleared the wat before the storm arrived. 農夫在暴風雨來之前先把小水道清理好。
The guidebook mentioned a Watala settlement near the coast. 那本指南提到海岸附近有一處瓦塔拉族聚落。
A Watala storyteller shared an old legend. 一位瓦塔拉族說故事的人分享了一則古老傳說。
The botany list included watap among rare plants. 植物學清單把這種罕見植物列為稀有植物之一。
A watap grew beside the shaded stream. 一株罕見植物長在陰影的小溪旁。
We watched a movie after dinner. 我們晚餐後看了一部電影。
Please watch your step on the slippery stairs. 樓梯很滑，請留意腳步。
The movie was simple but still watchable. 那部電影雖然簡單，卻仍然值得一看。
They found the old show surprisingly watchable. 他們發現那個老節目出奇地好看。
A watchboat circled the harbor after dark. 天黑後，一艘警戒船在港內巡行。
The crew waited on the watchboat for orders. 船員在守望船上等候命令。
The watchcase was scratched but still sturdy. 那個手錶錶殼雖然有刮痕，卻仍然結實。
He polished the silver watchcase carefully. 他仔細把銀色錶殼擦亮。
A sharp watchcry warned the camp of danger. 一聲尖銳的警報呼喊提醒營地有危險。
The lookout gave a watchcry from the wall. 瞭望者在牆上發出警戒喊聲。

meaning: 執行類似看門狗的功能；守護和警告。
sentences: To watchdog means to perform a function analogous to that of a watchdog; to guard and warn. 看門狗意味著執行類似於看門狗的功能；來守護和警告。
People may watchdog in different situations depending on the context. 人們可能會根據具體情況在不同的情況下看門狗。

meaning: 守望的；被監視的；看過的
sentences: They watched the road until midnight. 他們一直守望那條路到半夜。
The watched gate stayed quiet all evening. 那座被盯著的大門整個晚上都很安靜。
A bird watcher stood quietly by the lake. 一位賞鳥者安靜地站在湖邊。
The night watcher checked every door. 夜間守衛檢查了每一道門。
The preview was watchfree for one day. 試看片段可以免費觀看一天。
They offered a watchfree version of the concert. 他們提供了一版可免費觀看的演出。
The mother kept a watchful eye on her child. 母親留心看著孩子。
A watchful guard stood near the gate. 一名警覺的警衛站在門口附近。
She watched the crowd watchfully from the door. 她從門口警覺地觀察人群。
The dog sat watchfully beside the child. 那隻狗警惕地坐在孩子旁邊。
His watchfulness kept the group safe on the trail. 他的警覺讓隊伍在山路上保持安全。
The teacher praised the student's watchfulness. 老師稱讚那名學生很留神。
He poured a watchglassful of liquid into the vial. 他把一表皿量的液體倒進小瓶裡。
Only a watchglassful of solution was needed. 只需要一小表皿量的溶液。
The guard rested in the watchhouse after dawn. 天亮後，守衛在警衛室裡休息。
A small watchhouse stood by the city gate. 城門旁立著一間小小的守望屋。
Watching the kettle, Mia waited for it to boil. 米婭看著水壺，等它煮沸。
Watching the children, Dad stood near the pool. 爸爸留意著孩子們，站在泳池旁。
He looked watchingly at the doorway. 他目不轉睛地盯著門口。
The cat moved watchingly toward the bird. 那隻貓警覺地朝著鳥靠近。
The watchkeeper checked the gate every hour. 值守員每小時檢查一次大門。
A watchkeeper stayed near the lighthouse all night. 一名看守人整晚待在燈塔附近。
He felt watchless without his old wristwatch. 沒戴那隻舊手錶時，他覺得很不習慣。
A watchless guard can miss the smallest sign. 不留神的守衛可能會錯過最細微的徵兆。
A moment of watchlessness caused the mistake. 一時疏忽造成了這個錯誤。
The accident came from watchlessness on the stairs. 那場意外是因為在樓梯上不夠留神。
The watchmaker repaired the broken spring. 那位製錶師修好了斷掉的發條。
She took the old clock to a watchmaker nearby. 她把那只舊鐘拿到附近的製錶師那裡。
He studied watchmaking at a technical school. 他在技術學校學習製錶工藝。
The city is known for fine watchmaking. 這座城市以精良的鐘錶製作聞名。
The watchman walked the quiet street at night. 守夜人夜裡沿著安靜的街道巡走。
A watchman stood by the warehouse door. 看守人站在倉庫門旁。
His watchmanly habit kept him alert. 他那種像看守人的習慣讓他一直很警覺。
The old dog gave the yard a watchmanly air. 那隻老狗讓院子帶著一種警戒的氣氛。
The captain trusted her watchmanship on deck. 船長信任她在甲板上的守望本領。
Good watchmanship saved the camp from trouble. 出色的警戒能力讓營地避開了麻煩。
He and his watchmate took turns by the gate. 他和守望夥伴輪流守在大門旁。
A good watchmate never falls asleep on duty. 好的值班同伴絕不會在值勤時打瞌睡。
The watchment lasted through the cold rain. 那段值守工作一路持續到冷雨之中。
They shared the watchment without complaint. 他們毫無怨言地分擔守望工作。
He shouted a watchout before the turn. 他在轉彎前大聲提醒小心。
The sign gave a clear watchout for icy ground. 那個牌子對結冰地面提出了明確警告。
The soldiers climbed the watchtower at dawn. 士兵們在黎明時爬上瞭望塔。
From the watchtower, the whole valley was visible. 從望樓上可以看見整個山谷。
He moved watchwise along the dark corridor. 他沿著黑暗的走廊警覺地前進。
The puppy sat watchwise beside the door. 那隻小狗像在守望似地坐在門邊。
The watchwoman checked every window before midnight. 女看守在午夜前檢查了每扇窗戶。
A watchwoman stayed by the gate during the storm. 暴風雨期間，一名女守夜人守在門邊。
The watchword changed before the patrol began. 巡邏開始前口令改了。
Courage became their watchword for the campaign. 勇氣成了他們這次行動的口號。
The tiny gears showed the skill of watchwork. 那些小齒輪展現出製錶工藝的細膩。
He spent years learning the patience of watchwork. 他花了多年學習鐘錶工作的耐心。
It's important to drink plenty of water every day for your health. 每天喝充足的水對健康很重要。
The cat was happily drinking fresh water from its bowl. 貓正開心地喝著碗裡的清水。
The landlord included waterage in the rent. 房東把水費算進租金裡。
They were surprised by the high waterage this month. 他們對這個月高額的供水費用感到驚訝。

meaning: 抽水費；排水工作的費用
sentences: The farm paid a heavy waterbailage after the flood. 洪水過後，那個農場付了高額的抽水費。
The council set aside money for waterbailage. 市政單位撥出經費處理排水費用。
The doctor noticed signs of waterbelly in the patient. 醫生在病人身上注意到腹水的徵象。
The old term waterbelly described a swollen abdomen. 舊稱水腹用來描述腹部腫脹。
They planned a hike through Waterberg next spring. 他們打算明年春天徒步穿越瓦特貝格。
A Waterberg guide led the group up the ridge. 一位瓦特貝格導遊帶著隊伍上山脊。
A waterboard kept the canal from spilling over. 擋水板阻止運河溢出。
The workers replaced the broken waterboard quickly. 工人很快換掉了破損的導水板。
Waterbok grazed near the African river. 水羚在非洲河邊吃草。
Waterbok ran into tall grass at dusk. 水羚在黃昏跑進高草中。
The trail crossed a stretch of waterbosh. 小徑穿過一片濕地灌叢。
Birds hid in the thick waterbosh after rain. 雨後，鳥兒藏在濃密的沼澤叢林裡。

meaning: 腦袋遲鈍的人；反應慢的人
sentences: They mocked him as a waterbrain, which was cruel. 他們嘲笑他是腦袋遲鈍的人，這很殘忍。
No waterbrain could miss such an obvious clue. 再遲鈍的人也不會錯過這麼明顯的線索。
Their waterchat lasted until sunset. 他們在水邊閒聊到日落。
We had a short waterchat beside the stream. 我們在溪邊簡短地聊了幾句。
She filled the watercup at the spring. 她在泉邊把水杯裝滿。
Each desk had a small watercup beside it. 每張桌子旁邊都有一個小水杯。
A waterdoe watched the herd from the bank. 一隻雌水羚站在河岸看著獸群。
The waterdoe stepped carefully into the grass. 那隻雌水羚小心地踏進草地。
A single waterdrop slid down the leaf. 一滴水沿著葉子滑下。
He watched each waterdrop fall into the bowl. 他看著每一滴水落進碗裡。
She watered the garden before breakfast. 她在早餐前先給花園澆水。
The wine was watered by mistake. 那瓶酒不小心被加水稀釋了。
The waterer checked the plants every morning. 那位澆水的人每天早上都檢查植物。
A small waterer stood near the greenhouse door. 溫室門旁放著一個小型供水器。
We took a pleasant hike to see the magnificent mountain waterfall. 我們進行了一次愉快的健行，去觀賞壯觀的山間瀑布。
The water from the waterfall was crystal clear and cold as ice. 瀑布的水清澈見底且冰涼如冰。
The farmer hired a waterfinder for the new field. 農夫請了一位找水者來看新田地。
The old map tool acted as a waterfinder. 那個舊地圖工具相當於一個探水器。
A waterflood swept through the low fields. 洪水灌過低地。
The cellar filled fast when the waterflood broke through. 洪水湧進來時，地窖很快就滿了。

meaning: 水鳥；善於游水或涉水的鳥類
sentences: A flock of waterfowl landed on the pond. 一群水鳥落在池塘上。
The reserve protects many kinds of waterfowl. 這座保護區守護著許多種水鳥。
We walked along the waterfront after dinner. 晚餐後，我們沿著水岸散步。
New cafes opened on the waterfront. 濱水區開了幾家新咖啡店。
The canal began at a small waterhead. 那條運河起始於一處小水源頭。
Engineers checked the waterhead after the storm. 工程人員在暴風雨後檢查了引水處。

meaning: 水馬；傳說中的水中怪獸
sentences: The legend says a waterhorse lives in the loch. 傳說湖裡住著一隻水馬。
Children in the story feared the waterhorse at dusk. 故事裡的孩子們在黃昏時害怕那隻水馬。

meaning: 與水有關的人；常指供水工人
sentences: The waterie repaired the pipe before noon. 那位供水工人在中午前修好了水管。
Everyone thanked the waterie for restoring service. 大家都感謝那位供水工人恢復了供水。
The paint spread waterily across the paper. 那層顏料像水一樣在紙上暈開。
He smiled waterily after stepping out of the rain. 他走出雨中後，笑得濕漉漉的。
The wateriness of the soup made it taste weak. 這碗湯的稀薄感讓味道很淡。
She noticed the wateriness in the morning fog. 她注意到清晨薄霧中的濕潤水氣。
Watering the garden takes only a few minutes. 替花園澆水只要幾分鐘。
The watering system keeps the seedlings alive. 這套灌溉系統讓幼苗保持活力。
The farmer moved wateringly along the rows. 那位農夫沿著田列一邊走一邊灌溉。
She watered the plants wateringly at dawn. 她在黎明時分以灌溉方式給植物澆水。
The wateringman checked every valve on the line. 那位灌溉工檢查了管線上的每個閥門。
A wateringman kept the fields from drying out. 灌溉工讓田地不至於乾掉。

meaning: 含水的；稀薄的；淡而無味的
sentences: The sauce turned waterish after too much broth was added. 加了太多高湯後，醬汁變得很稀。
His eyes looked waterish from the cold wind. 他的眼睛因為冷風而顯得濕潤。

meaning: 稀薄地；濕潤地；像水一樣地
sentences: The soup moved waterishly in the bowl. 那碗湯在碗裡稀稀地晃動。
Her tears fell waterishly onto the page. 她的眼淚濕潤地落在頁面上。
The waterishness of the broth made it bland. 那鍋高湯的稀薄讓味道很淡。
He disliked the waterishness of the paint mixture. 他不喜歡那桶油漆混合物的稀薄感。
A Waterlander knew every canal in the town. 那位荷蘭水鄉居民熟悉鎮上的每條運河。
The guide said the old family were Waterlanders. 嚮導說那戶老家族是荷蘭水鄉人。

meaning: 與荷蘭水鄉地區有關的
sentences: The village kept its Waterlandian canals intact. 那座村莊保留了荷蘭水鄉式的運河景觀。
They praised the Waterlandian style of the houses. 他們稱讚那些房屋帶有荷蘭水鄉風格。

meaning: 水路離開；經由水面撤離
sentences: The crew made a quick waterleave at dawn. 船員在黎明時分迅速經水路撤離。
The plan called for a waterleave through the marsh. 計畫要求沿著沼澤地進行水路撤離。
The hikers crossed a waterless stretch of desert. 這些健行者穿過了一段無水的沙漠地帶。
The well went waterless after a long dry spell. 那口井在長時間乾旱後變得乾涸。
The stream ran waterlessly through the stones. 那條小溪在石縫間乾涸地流過。
The land lay waterlessly under the summer heat. 那片土地在夏日高溫下乾燥無水。
The waterlessness of the valley worried the farmers. 山谷的缺水狀態讓農民很擔心。
They studied the waterlessness of the old riverbed. 他們研究了那條古河床的乾涸情況。
The liquid was waterlike and almost colorless. 那液體像水一樣，幾乎沒有顏色。
A waterlike shine covered the glass surface. 一層像水一樣的光澤覆在玻璃表面。

meaning: 水線；船身接觸水面的線
sentences: The boat's waterline sat higher after unloading. 船卸貨後，水線上升了。
A mark on the hull showed the old waterline. 船殼上的痕跡標出了舊水線。
Heavy rain can waterlog the field in hours. 大雨幾個小時內就能把田地泡得積水難行。
The storm waterlogged the road and delayed traffic. 暴風雨讓道路積水，交通因此延誤。
The path was waterlogged after three days of rain. 連下三天雨後，小路積水嚴重。
They could not use the waterlogged tent again. 那頂泡水的帳篷已經不能再用了。
The waterloggedness of the ground slowed the work. 地面的積水狀態拖慢了工作。
They measured the waterloggedness before planting. 他們在播種前先測量了土壤積水程度。

meaning: 喜歡泡在水裡的人；使物件浸水的人
sentences: The waterlogger spent all afternoon near the pond. 那個愛泡水的人整個下午都待在池邊。
He jokingly called himself a waterlogger after the swim. 游完泳後，他開玩笑說自己像個泡水的人。
Waterlogging ruined the crop in the lower field. 積水毀掉了下方田地的作物。
The engineers fixed the drainage to stop waterlogging. 工程人員修好排水系統，避免再積水。
The debate was his Waterloo. 那場辯論成了他的滑鐵盧。
The company faced its Waterloo after the failed launch. 那家公司在失敗的上市後遭遇了滑鐵盧。
The waterman ferried people across the river. 那位船夫把人們擺渡過河。
An old waterman told stories of the harbor. 一位老船夫講起港口的往事。
Good watermanship matters on rough seas. 在風浪大的海面上，操船技巧很重要。
The course teaches basic watermanship and safety. 這門課教授基本操船技巧與安全知識。
The certificate had a faint watermark. 那張證書上有淡淡的水印。
She held the paper to the light to see the watermark. 她把紙對著光看水印。
The watermaster controlled the canal gates. 那位管水者控制著運河閘門。
Farmers met the watermaster to discuss allocations. 農民與管水人討論分配方案。
Watermelon is a refreshing fruit to eat on a hot summer day. 西瓜是炎炎夏日裡清涼解暑的水果。
Taiwan is famous for its large, sweet, and juicy watermelons. 台灣以其巨大、甜美且多汁的西瓜聞名。
The watermonger delivered jugs to each house. 那位賣水的人把水罐送到每戶人家。
In the market, the watermonger shouted his prices. 在市場裡，水商大聲叫賣價格。
The composer used a waterphone for a tense scene. 作曲家在緊張場景裡使用了水琴。
Its eerie sound made the waterphone hard to forget. 那種詭異音色讓水琴很難讓人忘記。
She carried a clay waterpot on her head. 她頭上頂著一個陶製水壺。
The old waterpot sat near the kitchen door. 那個舊水壺放在廚房門邊。
The jacket is made of a high-quality waterproof material for rainy days. 這件外套是由適合雨天穿的高品質防水材料製成的。
Please make sure your phone case is waterproof before going swimming. 游泳前請確保你的手機殼是防水的。

meaning: 愛抱怨的人；老是發牢騷的人
sentences: The team was tired of the same old whinger. 團隊已經受夠了那個老愛抱怨的人。
She ignored the whinger and kept working. 她不理那個愛發牢騷的人，繼續做事。
The whininess in his voice made the room tense. 他聲音裡的哀怨感讓房間氣氛緊張。
Her whininess annoyed everyone at the table. 她那種愛抱怨的語氣惹惱了桌邊所有人。

meaning: 哀怨地；帶著抱怨口氣地
sentences: He spoke whiningly when the plan changed. 計畫一改變，他就哀怨地說話。
The puppy looked up whiningly for food. 那隻小狗帶著哀怨的神情抬頭討食。

meaning: 輕聲嘶鳴；短促的馬鳴聲
sentences: A soft whinnel came from the stable. 馬廄裡傳出一聲輕柔的嘶鳴。
He heard a whinnel before the horse moved. 馬動身前，他先聽到一聲短促馬鳴。
The whinner called from the field at dusk. 傍晚時，那匹嘶鳴的馬從田裡叫了起來。
Nobody liked working with such a whinner. 沒有人喜歡和那種老抱怨的人共事。

meaning: 微弱的馬鳴聲；短促嘶聲
sentences: The whinnock was barely audible in the rain. 那聲短促嘶鳴在雨中幾乎聽不見。
A whinnock drifted from the dark barn. 黑暗的穀倉裡飄來一聲微弱馬鳴。
The horse gave a short whinny outside the gate. 那匹馬在門外發出短促的嘶鳴。
A whinny came from the stall after feeding time. 喂食時間過後，馬廄裡傳出一聲馬嘶。
The wall was built from rough whinstone. 那面牆是用粗糙的硬黑石砌成的。
Whinstone chips crunched under their boots. 他們靴子下的硬黑石碎片嘎吱作響。
The whiny tone made the request hard to hear. 那種愛抱怨的語氣讓請求聽起來很刺耳。
He sounded whiny after waiting too long. 他等太久之後，說話就帶著哭腔。
The old soldier carried a whinyard at his side. 那位老兵腰邊掛著一把短劍。
A whinyard hung above the fireplace as a relic. 壁爐上方掛著一把短劍作為古物。
The rider used a leather whip to encourage the horse to run. 騎手用皮鞭鼓勵馬兒跑動。
She learned how to whip fresh cream until it becomes thick. 她學會了如何攪打（鞭打）鮮奶油直到變稠。

meaning: 細長的腹部；身形纖細的人
sentences: The whipbelly of the boat made it move fast. 船身細長的腹部讓船行得很快。
He joked that the athlete was a whipbelly. 他開玩笑說那位運動員身形十分纖細。

meaning: 鞭鳥；叫聲像甩鞭子的鳥
sentences: A whipbird called sharply from the trees. 一隻鞭鳥在樹林裡尖銳鳴叫。
The whipbird's cry sounded like a crack of leather. 鞭鳥的叫聲聽起來像皮鞭一響。

meaning: 鞭索；類似九尾鞭的工具
sentences: The old coachman kept a whipcat on the seat. 那位老車夫把鞭索放在座位上。
A whipcat was hanging beside the stable door. 馬廄門邊掛著一條鞭索。

meaning: 鞭索；又細又硬的強韌繩索
sentences: The parcel was tied with sturdy whipcord. 包裹用結實的鞭索綁著。
Whipcord was strong enough for the heavy load. 那種強韌繩索足以承受重物。
He had a whipcordy frame from years of labor. 多年勞動讓他有一副纖細結實的身形。
The rope looked whipcordy and very tough. 那條繩子看起來像鞭索一樣又細又韌。
The whipcrack echoed across the field. 鞭響在田野上回蕩。
She heard a whipcrack from the training ring. 她從訓練場聽到一聲清脆的抽打聲。

meaning: 甩鞭的人；喜歡抽響鞭子的人
sentences: The whipcracker stood in the center of the yard. 那個甩鞭的人站在院子中央。
Everyone turned when the whipcracker raised his arm. 當那位甩鞭的人抬起手臂時，大家都轉過頭去。
He learned whipcraft from an experienced rider. 他向一位有經驗的騎手學習鞭技。
Good whipcraft takes patience and control. 好的鞭技需要耐心與控制力。

meaning: 舌接法；一種植物嫁接方式
sentences: The gardener used a whipgraft on the young tree. 園丁在幼樹上用了舌接法。
A clean whipgraft can help two stems grow together. 乾淨的舌接法能讓兩根枝條一起生長。

meaning: 由鞭索驅動的裝置；簡單提升器
sentences: The old shop used a whipjack to lift the beam. 那間舊工坊用鞭索驅動的裝置來抬梁木。
He repaired the whipjack before the work began. 開工前，他先修好了那個簡單提升器。
The arena crowd cheered for the whipking. 競技場觀眾為那位鞭技高手歡呼。
He acted like a whipking during the parade. 遊行時，他表現得像個強勢駕馭者。
To whiplash means to jerk back and forth; to buffet. 鞭打的意思是來回猛拉；自助餐。
People may whiplash in different situations depending on the context. 根据具体情况，人们可能会在不同的情况下挥鞭。

meaning: 像鞭子的；細長而有彈性的
sentences: The branch had a whiplike bend at the end. 那根樹枝末端有鞭子般的彎曲。
Her whiplike movements were quick and sharp. 她那種像鞭子一樣的動作又快又俐落。
The whipmaker worked in a small workshop. 那位製鞭者在一間小工坊裡工作。
A skilled whipmaker can shape the handle neatly. 熟練的製鞭者能把把手做得很精緻。

meaning: 製鞭工藝；做鞭子的過程
sentences: Whipmaking was once a common village trade. 製鞭工藝曾經是鄉村常見的行業。
He studied whipmaking before opening a shop. 他在開店前先學習製鞭。
The whipman sat on the front seat of the cart. 那位趕車人坐在馬車前座。
A careful whipman never struck the horse hard. 細心的趕車人從不重重抽打馬匹。

meaning: 鞭技；用鞭子的熟練本領
sentences: The show was impressive because of his whipmanship. 那場表演因為他的鞭技而令人印象深刻。
Whipmanship takes steady hands and timing. 鞭技需要穩定的雙手與準確的時機。
The whipmaster taught the children how to swing safely. 那位鞭技師傅教孩子們如何安全地揮動鞭子。
Everyone trusted the whipmaster's calm voice. 大家都信任那位鞭子高手沉穩的聲音。
He could whippa the rope through the air. 他能把繩子猛力揮過空中。
The rider used the whip to whippa the reins lightly. 騎手用鞭子輕輕抽動韁繩。

meaning: 可鞭打的；可快速攪打的
sentences: The mixture was whippable after a few minutes. 這個混合物幾分鐘後就可以打發。

He heard a whipparee and then silence. 他先聽到一記鞭打，接著就安靜下來。

meaning: 被抽打的；打發好的；筋疲力盡的
sentences: She whipped the cream until it was fluffy. 她把奶油打到蓬鬆為止。
By the end of the hike, he felt whipped. 走到最後，他已經累得筋疲力盡。

meaning: 抽打者；鞭子或攪拌器的使用者
sentences: The whipper stood beside the wagon. 那位抽打者站在馬車旁邊。
A quick whipper can move a rope with precision. 熟練的抽打者能精準揮動繩子。

meaning: 乳臭未乾的小子；狂妄年輕人
sentences: The old man scolded the whippersnapper for talking back. 老人因為那個乳臭未乾的小子頂嘴而責備他。
No one liked the loud whippersnapper in the room. 房裡沒有人喜歡那個大聲嚷嚷的年輕人。

meaning: 鞭尾；尾巴細長如鞭的鳥或動物
sentences: The whippertail darted across the sand. 那隻鞭尾生物飛快地穿過沙地。
A whippertail bird flicked its long tail in the sun. 一隻尾巴細長如鞭的鳥在陽光下甩動長尾。

meaning: 惠比特犬；一種細長敏捷的犬種
sentences: The whippet raced across the yard in seconds. 那隻惠比特犬幾秒內就衝過院子。

A careful whippeter knows when to stop. 謹慎的揮鞭者知道什麼時候該停下。

meaning: 柔韌性；像鞭子一樣易彎的特性
sentences: The whippiness of the branch helped it bend without breaking. 樹枝的柔韌性讓它彎曲而不折斷。
She liked the whippiness of the new rope. 她喜歡那條新繩子的柔韌感。
The whipping of the rope made a sharp sound in the wind. 繩子在風中快速抽動，發出清脆聲響。
No one wanted to see whipping used as punishment. 沒有人想看到把鞭打當成懲罰。

meaning: 像抽鞭子一樣地；迅速地
sentences: The wind moved whippingly across the open field. 風像抽鞭子一樣迅速掠過空曠田野。
He turned whippingly and ran toward the gate. 他迅速轉身，朝大門跑去。

meaning: 挽具橫木；連接兩匹牲口的橫樑
sentences: The cart was hitched with a whippletree. 那輛車用挽具橫木連接起來。
The farmer checked the whippletree before starting out. 農夫出發前先檢查那根挽具橫木。
A whippoorwill called from the dark hillside. 一隻夜鷹在黑暗山坡上鳴叫。

meaning: 鞭刑柱；用來鞭打的柱子
sentences: The old story mentioned a whippost in the square. 那個老故事提到廣場上的鞭刑柱。

The whippowill sang throughout the warm night. 那隻夜鷹整個溫暖夜晚都在鳴唱。

meaning: 柔韌的；像鞭子一樣易彎的
sentences: The whippy stem bent in the breeze. 那根柔韌的莖在微風中彎了起來。
He liked the whippy feel of the new fishing rod. 他喜歡那支新釣竿的柔韌手感。

meaning: 長柄雙人鋸；使兩面夾擊
sentences: Two workers used a whipsaw to cut the log. 兩名工人用長柄雙人鋸鋸開原木。
The trader felt a whipsaw from sudden price swings. 那名交易員受到價格劇烈波動的雙面夾擊。

meaning: 快速航行的船；急速前進的船隻
sentences: The whipship raced across the narrow channel. 那艘快速航行的船飛快穿過狹窄海峽。
The captain praised the whipship for its speed. 船長稱讚那艘船的速度很快。

meaning: 鞭柄插孔；固定鞭子的座口
sentences: The handle fit tightly into the whipsocket. 那個手柄緊密地卡進鞭柄插孔。
He repaired the whipsocket before the ride. 他在騎乘前先修好了鞭柄插孔。

meaning: 舊式操舵桿；船上的舵桿
sentences: The sailor gripped the whipstaff with both hands. 那名水手雙手握住舵桿。
Old ships were often steered by a whipstaff. 舊式船隻常靠舵桿來操縱。

meaning: 鞭狀莖；細長且彎曲的莖
sentences: A whipstalk rose from the center of the plant. 一根鞭狀莖從植物中央長出來。
The gardener trimmed the whipstalk carefully. 園丁小心地修剪那根細長莖。

meaning: 鞭具攤位；售賣鞭子的攤位
sentences: They found a whipstall at the old market. 他們在舊市場找到一個賣鞭具的攤位。

meaning: 精力旺盛的人；機靈又敏捷的人
sentences: He was a real whipster on the basketball court. 他在籃球場上真是個機靈又敏捷的人。
The young whipster finished the task in minutes. 那個靈活的小夥子幾分鐘內就把工作做完了。

meaning: 鞭狀木棒；細長彈性的棍子
sentences: He cut a whipstick from the willow tree. 他從柳樹上砍下一根細長木棒。
The whipstick bent without snapping. 那根鞭狀木棒彎了卻沒有折斷。

meaning: 包邊縫；用來收邊的針腳
sentences: She finished the edge with a whipstitch. 她用包邊縫完成布料邊緣。
The whipstitch kept the fabric from fraying. 那種針腳讓布料不容易鬆邊。
The whipstock cracked after years of use. 那根鞭柄在使用多年後裂開了。
He polished the whipstock until it shone. 他把鞭柄擦到發亮。

meaning: 已鞭打的；whipped 的舊拼法
sentences: The whipt grass bent low after the storm. 風暴過後，那些被壓彎的草垂得很低。
Old texts sometimes used the spelling whipt. 舊文獻有時會使用這種拼法。
Whiptail was noticed on the kitchen table. 受到注意在廚房桌上。
Whiptail was used on the rainy walk home. 被使用在下雨回家路上。

meaning: 細枝樹；枝條像鞭子一樣柔長的樹
sentences: The whiptree swayed in the strong wind. 那棵細枝樹在強風中搖擺。
Its long branches gave the whiptree its name. 它細長的枝條讓這棵樹得了這個名字。
The branch bent whipwise under the pressure. 樹枝在壓力下像鞭子一樣彎下去。
He moved whipwise through the crowd. 他迅疾地穿過人群。

meaning: 嗡嗡聲；呼呼作響；急速轉動
sentences: The whir of the fan filled the room. 電風扇的嗡嗡聲充滿整個房間。

He watched the plate whirken slowly on the stand. 他看著盤子在架子上慢慢旋轉。
Whirl happened during the morning lesson. 發生了在早晨課堂上。
Whirl continued during the morning lesson. 持續進行在早晨課堂上。
The child made a whirlabout on the grass. 那個孩子在草地上轉了一圈。
The dance ended with a quick whirlabout. 舞蹈以一個快速旋轉收尾。

meaning: 旋風；帶著強烈旋轉的風
sentences: A whirlblast of dust crossed the road. 一陣旋風般的塵土穿過道路。
The tent shook in the whirlblast. 帳篷在旋風中搖晃。

meaning: 可旋轉的骨節；轉動感很強的骨頭
sentences: The doctor checked the whirlbone near the ankle. 醫生檢查了腳踝附近那個可轉動的骨節。
He felt a sharp pain in the whirlbone. 他感到那個骨節一陣刺痛。

meaning: 心思轉得很快的人；思緒飛快的人
sentences: She was a whirlbrain who jumped from idea to idea. 她是個思緒飛快的人，總是一個想法接一個想法。
The teacher told the whirlbrain to slow down. 老師叫那個腦子轉得很快的學生慢一點。
The dancer whirled across the stage. 舞者在舞台上旋轉而過。
The leaves whirled in the autumn wind. 葉子在秋風中飛旋。
The whirler spun around with a loud laugh. 那個旋轉者一邊大笑一邊轉圈。
The machine used a small whirler to mix the paint. 那台機器用一個小旋轉裝置來攪拌油漆。

meaning: 旋轉物；快速轉動的東西
sentences: The toy was a colorful whirley. 那個玩具是一個彩色旋轉物。
The whirley spun until it fell over. 那個旋轉玩具一直轉，直到倒下。

meaning: 旋轉玩具；會快速打轉的東西
sentences: The child loved the old whirlgig in the yard. 那個孩子很喜歡院子裡那個舊旋轉玩具。
A small whirlgig spun in the wind. 一個小小的旋轉玩具在風中轉動。
The whirlicane tore through the empty field. 那場旋風席捲了空曠田地。
The villagers ran inside when the whirlicane came. 旋風來臨時，村民趕緊跑進屋內。
The whirligig spun so fast that the colors blurred. 那個旋轉玩具轉得太快，顏色都看糊了。
Children crowded around the whirligig at the fair. 孩子們在市集上圍著旋轉玩具。

meaning: 花俏的旋轉裝置；亂轉的玩意
sentences: The whirlimagig on the shelf kept spinning slowly. 架子上的花俏旋轉裝置慢慢轉個不停。

The whirling fan made a soft sound. 旋轉的風扇發出輕微聲音。
Leaves were whirling in the wind. 葉子在風中打轉。
The snow moved whirlingly across the road. 雪花旋轉著掠過道路。
The dancers turned whirlingly under the lights. 舞者在燈光下飛快旋轉。

meaning: 旋轉物；花俏的轉動玩意
sentences: The child pointed at the bright whirlmagee on the table. 那個孩子指著桌上那個鮮亮的旋轉物。
No one knew what the whirlmagee was for. 沒人知道那個花俏轉動玩意是做什麼的。
A small whirlpool formed near the drain. 排水口附近形成一個小漩渦。
The boat avoided the dangerous whirlpool. 船避開了危險的漩渦。

meaning: 旋起的一團氣流；小旋風
sentences: A whirlpuff of dust rose from the floor. 一團旋起的塵土從地板上升起。
The kite disappeared into a whirlpuff of wind. 那隻風箏消失在一陣小旋風裡。

meaning: 愛亂轉的人；快速轉動的小東西
sentences: The little whirlwig never sat still for long. 那個小傢伙總是坐不住，像個愛亂轉的人。
A metal whirlwig spun on the table. 一個金屬小轉物在桌上轉動。

meaning: 猛烈向前掃過的人或物體或事件。
sentences: Once he got that new scooter he turned into a whirlwind and damaged all the flowers. 一旦他得到了那輛新摩托車，他就變成了旋風，損壞了所有的花朵。

meaning: 像旋風的；急促而猛烈的
sentences: The debate had a whirlwindish pace. 那場辯論的節奏像旋風一樣急促。
Her whirlwindish arrival startled everyone. 她像旋風般出現，把大家都嚇了一跳。

meaning: 帶旋風感的；風大而急的
sentences: The afternoon felt whirlwindy and unstable. 那個下午又急又亂，帶著旋風感。

The whirly toy rolled off the table. 那個旋轉玩具從桌上滾了下來。
She drew a whirly pattern on the page. 她在頁面上畫了一個旋轉圖案。

meaning: 旋轉小玩意；花俏的小轉具
sentences: The whirlygigum on the desk spun in the breeze. 桌上的旋轉小玩意在微風中轉動。

meaning: 嗡嗡地轉動；發出低沉轉聲
